evaluations.rationale: The broad plan remains valid and supplies the enabled, disabled, revoked, and project-role regression route. It is deferred in favor of the generated matrix because that matrix names the exact branch and the enabled control that discriminate the competing explanations.

Selected. It directly tests a validly signed account token whose stored identifier is intact but whose current enabled state is false, with an enabled control and a re-enable cleanup. This gives a causal result and a minimal repair target.

Deferred, not refuted. The project-role branch does precede account handling, but a role subject is not a local account, so disablement is not ordinarily expected to invalidate it. It remains a valuable post-repair regression.
Deferred and folded into the selected test as a control. A fresh settings view with identical signing material separates stale object state from a missing predicate without changing the repair.
Deferred, not refuted. A full middleware check could reveal anonymous fallback, but it needs a larger server fixture. It is a follow-up check after parser behavior is observed.
Deferred, not refuted. An identifier/state race is a distinct concurrency hypothesis, but the visible path is synchronous and no cleanup window is evident yet. It needs a separate stagger fixture.
